items.heading: Empanadas de Pino
details: Key ingredients: flour dough, ground beef, onion, olive, egg
Slow-cook ground beef with a large amount of onion until jammy.
Season with cumin and paprika, then cool the filling.
Fill dough rounds with the beef, a slice of boiled egg and an olive.
Fold, crimp and bake or fry until golden.

items.heading: Pastel de Choclo
details: Key ingredients: ground corn, ground beef, onion, chicken, olives
Layer a savory filling of ground beef, onion, chicken and olives in a baking dish.
Blend fresh corn kernels with basil into a thick puree.
Spread the corn puree evenly over the meat filling.
Bake until the top is set and lightly caramelized.
